units.source_text: “班女闺中秋扇色，楚王台上夜琴声。”

en.t: In Lady Ban's chamber is the color of an autumn fan; on King Chu's terrace is the sound of a zither at night.
This line appears in the Wakan Roeishu.

units.source_text: 汉成帝的宫女班婕妤失宠，曾自比秋扇而赋诗。

en.t: Lady Ban, a palace woman of Emperor Cheng of Han, lost his favor and once wrote a poem comparing herself to an autumn fan.

units.source_text: 因浮舟手持白扇，故薰君想起此诗。

en.t: Because Ukifune was holding a white fan in her hand, Lord Kaoru was reminded of this poem.

units.source_text: 但他只说出下句，暗示上一句。

en.t: But he spoke only the second line, hinting at the first.
